limitations: NOS does not mean absence of mucin. These are variable visual descriptions, not necessary or sufficient diagnostic criteria.
The mucinous diagnosis is a whole-tumor histologic classification; no patch-level percentage threshold is asserted.
COAD versus READ, MSI, mutations, stage, prognosis and treatment response are not class descriptors.
Use the explicit clinical histological subtype; do not infer non-papillary from a generic NOS code.
Papillary is an architectural designation, not a claim of low grade or non-invasion. Both classes can have invasive components.
Non-papillary is a broad clinical category; no single growth pattern is mandatory on every slide.
No mutation, expression, prognosis, treatment response or molecular subtype is asserted from H&E.
